## Appearance

Gilbert Blythe is a tall, manly lad with broad shoulders and curly brown hair. He has a frank face with clear, straightforward, and roguish hazel eyes, alongside a mouth often twisted into a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. ## Personality

Gilbert Blythe is a clever, good-natured, and popular young man with a strong determination to make the most of his life and contribute positively to the world. Driven to earn his own way through college, he initially aims to secure a First Class teacher's license in a single year. Looking further ahead, he aspires to become a doctor so he can do honest work fighting disease, pain, and ignorance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## History

Gilbert Blythe's relationship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) began contentiously when he taunted her by calling her "Carrots" and pulling her hair at school, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head and reject his attempt to apologize. During their school years, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) maintained a fierce academic rivalry with Gilbert, even after being forced to sit with him as a school punishment. Although Gilbert rescued [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when her boat sank during a play, she initially rejected his offer of friendship, though his presence in the crowd later helped her overcome stage fright at a charity concert. At Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Gilbert won the medal while competing alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and he subsequently gave up his position as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school teacher so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could stay home near [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), which finally led [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile with him and become a close friend. As they began their respective teaching careers, Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frequently met to discuss their school experiences, debate educational methods, and plan projects for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepted an opportunity to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), she and Gilbert shared a quiet, romantic moment together following Miss Lavendar's wedding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> “All right!” Gilbert sprang into his skiff with an angry color in his cheeks. “I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)

> “Not she,” said Gilbert emphatically. “I know Louisa Spencer well. She doesn’t ‘believe’ in Village Improvement Societies, but she does believe in dollars and cents. She’d be more likely to urge Judson on than to dissuade him.”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P46](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0046)

> "and I’ve given that up in despair. Levi won’t have it taken down just to vex us. There’s a contrary streak in all the Boulters and it’s strongly developed in him."

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert's relationship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began in school when he taunted her hair and she violently rejected his apology, sparking a years-long academic rivalry between them. Despite her early hostility, Gilbert developed romantic feelings for her, picking up her rose and eventually rescuing her from a sinking boat on the pond. Over time, their dynamic softened into a deep friendship where they agreed to help each other with their studies and share quiet, romantic moments together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), +25 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Gilbert and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) maintained an intense academic rivalry throughout their school years, competing for top honors in their class. Their competition culminated in Gilbert winning the school medal while [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) won the Avery Scholarship. Eventually, after completing their teaching duties in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), the two shared a peaceful, romantic moment following Miss Lavendar's wedding as they both prepared for the next chapter of their lives.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +9 more_

- Rival of — academic rivals in school  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
